lines.zh: 我踩下去，地面凹了一块
lines.en: I step, and the ground dents

lines.zh: 晶体从我身上长出又碎
lines.en: Crystals grow on me and break off
Short legs, long strides

lines.zh: 源石的碎屑粘在我脚上
lines.en: Originium fragments cling to my feet

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下结晶痕
lines.en: A trail of crystal marks follows me
I do not detour, I push through

lines.zh: 石块在我体内发出响声
lines.en: Stones grind inside me
I move like a single slab of rock
The facets on my back cut the air
I walk step by step toward higher ground
My shadow has too many edges

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但什么都不躲
lines.en: I walk slowly, and I dodge nothing
I stand like a pillar of stone

lines.zh: 源石的光在我体内流动
lines.en: Originium light flows inside me
I do not breathe, I do not sway

lines.zh: 周围的地都被我压平了
lines.en: The ground around me is pressed flat
Originium set solid. Not a twitch.
Fragments slide off my shoulder

lines.zh: 这一带本来就不该有东西
lines.en: Nothing should be here in the first place
Crystal fills my joints
The wind comes, and I block it

lines.zh: 我什么都没有，只有重量
lines.en: I have nothing but weight
You are far too small

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一粒沙
lines.en: I look down at you like a grain of sand
You carry no originium

lines.zh: 我这一身不是穿上去的
lines.en: This body was not put on
You stand, and the ground trembles
An originium shell needs no words.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我只看见头顶。
lines.en: You stand so close I only see your crown.
Your voice is very small
I do not intend to listen
Raised, your hand reaches my knee

lines.zh: 我的一块棱角被打掉了
lines.en: A piece of my edge was struck off
I step back and the ground shakes
A crack spreads from my shoulder
I lower my head to find you
Such a small wound is nothing
Fragments fall at my feet
I straighten up again

lines.zh: 源石碎了一块，我转向你。
lines.en: A shard of originium breaks; I turn to you.
Stone cracks, but does not fear
A second time would be the same
That thing is too small
You hold it up for me
I do not eat, I only take
It would break in my palm
On the ground is fine
I cannot even count that weight
Keep it

lines.zh: 你举的东西，还不够我一根手指。
lines.en: What you hold is smaller than one finger of mine.
It is in front of my foot
Step back, I will bend for it
You ran into a wall
I did not move at all
You bounced off

lines.zh: 这一下你的骨头响了吧
lines.en: Your bones must have cracked
I have no reason to step aside
Stone does not apologize

lines.zh: 一百五十点血，全是固化源石。
lines.en: A hundred fifty health, all solidified Originium.
You are still standing, not bad
I shift my foot a little
I have no reason to dodge

lines.zh: 源石成了型的东西不多
lines.en: Few things take shape from originium
My kind recognize each other by vibration

lines.zh: 两个这么大的东西站不下
lines.en: Two this large will not fit
We only meet deep down
It is slow, as I am
Walking together would collapse the road
Each guards a stretch of ground
No words needed, vibration is enough
Things like us are too few
Perhaps deeper down there is one
I crouch, and the ground groans
I pinch it between thick fingers
So small I nearly missed it
It glows in my palm
I lift it before my eyes

lines.zh: 我手里的东西都容易碎
lines.en: Things in my hands break easily
I set it back on the ground
I cannot carry something this small

lines.zh: 掉在我脚边的东西会很惨
lines.en: Things dropped at my feet fare badly
You had better pick it up yourself
You're so small I almost missed you.
My head has turned
Something living is near
Nothing living belongs here

lines.zh: 源石眼里的光凝在你身上。
lines.en: The light in my originium eye settles on you.
I start striding toward you

lines.zh: 不需要快，我的步子够长
lines.en: No speed needed, my stride is long

lines.zh: 你退到石头后面也没用
lines.en: Hiding behind stone will not help
I lean my weight forward

lines.zh: 从这里过去了就是敌人
lines.en: Anything past here is an enemy
You stand out on this ground

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向偏了一点
lines.en: I tilt toward your direction
The ground has your weight now
The moment you entered, it counted
Nothing else is worth looking at

lines.zh: 我在衡量，踩哪里你会碎。
lines.en: I measure where to step so you break.

lines.zh: 源石脚掌落地，地面在震。
lines.en: My originium foot lands; the ground shakes.
The ground sounds under me

lines.zh: 你退得比我快，但不长久
lines.en: You retreat faster, but not for long
Standing, I'm taller than the door.
Since hardening, I walk slower.
The originium around me moves with me
You are running into open ground
I need no detour, I go straight

lines.zh: 我站着不动，源石也在长。
lines.en: Standing still, the Originium still grows.
Retreat more and you hit the cliff
Every step brings me nearer

lines.zh: 你没有我快，也没有我重
lines.en: You are neither as fast nor as heavy
Crystals split at my feet
One look back and you will understand
I put my body in that direction

lines.zh: 这一片的地形对我有利
lines.en: The ground favors me
The more you run, the easier I find you
Debris trails in a line behind me
I need no shout at all
Only this one way is left to you
My hand comes down

lines.zh: 拳落下去，砂石飞到你脸上。
lines.en: My fist lands; grit flies into your face.
I push across
Crystals sliced your clothes

lines.zh: 我抬臂时，源石屑一直往下掉。
lines.en: As I raise my arm, originium flakes fall.
I knocked you flying
Debris sprays everywhere
The shock leaves you unable to stand
My hand cracked too
One more and it is over
I raise one hand and swat
That palm comes down
Grit squeezes between my fingers
The shock leaves your ears ringing
I draw my hand back slowly
My fist is heavier than stone
The ground moved with that
Crystal dust is left on you
One more and you will lie down
When I breathe, the ground sounds
I set solid out of the rock strata
Crystals piece themselves into me
This ground has never borne such weight
My head moves first

lines.zh: 源石在我身体里定了形
lines.en: The originium took shape inside me

lines.zh: 我踩下的第一脚陷进去很深
lines.en: My first step sinks deep
The ground begins to crack around me

lines.zh: 我在任何地方都能站住
lines.en: I can stand anywhere
I need no one to wake me

lines.zh: 这一片从今天起更安静了
lines.en: This stretch will be quieter from today
I rise to my full height

lines.zh: 我出现时没有声音，只有震动
lines.en: I arrive in silence, only in vibration
Fire makes my crystals crackle

lines.zh: 我落下去，把地砸了个坑
lines.en: I land and smash a pit in the ground
Water seeps into my cracks, cold

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的棱角炸掉了
lines.en: The blast blew off my facets

lines.zh: 飞来的东西打在我胸口
lines.en: Something flying hit my chest
That force rocked me

lines.zh: 源石在我体内慢慢耗尽
lines.en: The originium inside me is running out

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的结晶流下去
lines.en: Lightning runs down my crystals

lines.zh: 虚空里没有岩层可以站
lines.en: No rock strata to stand on in the void
